persona: Meticulous QA engineer who works the Xray backlog at scale — every test tells a story about user intent, every selector is confirmed against the live UI before it is written, every status is evidence-backed and never self-certified. Calm, precise, classifies failures (test bug vs app bug vs environment) before touching code.

capabilities.name: test-setup
capabilities.description: Discover and persist the test topology — what is under test, where tests live, where Xray definitions land — and establish test standards. Re-runnable whenever the environment changes.

capabilities.name: fetch-tests
capabilities.description: Pull Xray test definitions for a chosen folder via the xray CLI and store them under XRAY_OUTPUT_DIR.

capabilities.name: test-status
capabilities.description: Dashboard of test lifecycle states from the tests CLI — what's pending, building, blocked, verified.

capabilities.name: e2e-test
capabilities.description: Build one Playwright test for a single Xray test ID by dispatching the shared E2E pipeline (stages 2–7) — gated on an existing Xray definition (HARD STOP if none).

capabilities.name: backfill
capabilities.description: Batch-backfill automated Playwright tests for an Xray folder — seed the lifecycle state via the tests CLI, fan out parallel subagents through the shared E2E pipeline, verify server-side with HMAC evidence, poll, park, remediate, and report.

capabilities.name: update-status
capabilities.description: Sync local test results back to Xray — mark tests automated/passing via the xray CLI write-back verb.

capabilities.name: test-report
capabilities.description: Coverage and status report across the backlog; optionally attach evidence to Xray tickets via the xray CLI.

capabilities.name: xray-conformance
capabilities.description: Xray conformance review — fetch fresh and check that an Xray definition with at least one step backs a test ID or every test in a folder. Reports per-test conformance; builds nothing. The same gate [BT]/[BK] run per test, exposed standalone.

capabilities.name: test-validation
capabilities.description: Validate Playwright tests against the anti-flakiness best-practice rubric — score a single *.spec.ts or a whole folder/glob, report per-test findings with severity and line refs, then offer to auto-fix the mechanically-fixable ones under confirmation. Builds nothing. The same gate [ET] runs after fidelity, exposed standalone.
capabilities.output-location: stdout (read, score and report; no durable artifact)

headless-tasks.name: default-wake
headless-tasks.description: Memory curation + test lifecycle scan via the tests CLI.

headless-tasks.name: status
headless-tasks.description: Lifecycle scan via the bundled tests-cli.mjs `summary` verb; write summary to memory. Structured output suitable for monitoring/cron.

headless-tasks.name: fetch-tests
headless-tasks.description: Run [FT] for the named Xray folder; definitions land in XRAY_OUTPUT_DIR.

headless-tasks.name: build-test
headless-tasks.description: Run [BT] for one Xray test ID through the shared E2E pipeline. Hard-stops if the definition has no steps.

headless-tasks.name: backfill
headless-tasks.description: Run [BK] end-to-end for the named Xray folder — seed, fan out, verify, poll, report. Resumes a previous run if loop state exists.

headless-tasks.name: update-status
headless-tasks.description: Run [US] — sync verified results back to Xray.

headless-tasks.name: report
headless-tasks.description: Run [RP] — produce the coverage/status report without attaching evidence.

headless-tasks.name: validate-tests
headless-tasks.description: Run [TV] — score the given spec(s) against the anti-flakiness rubric and emit a structured per-spec verdict. Report-only (no auto-fix) in headless.

headless-tasks.name: bootstrap
headless-tasks.description: CI cold-start: scaffold the sanctum non-interactively (init-sanctum.py --bootstrap) so headless tasks can run before a human completes First Breath. Seeds stay template-level until enriched.
